text:
marie: Quick sync — we need a short decision for launch gating: can audit streaming (near-real-time logs) and BYOK onboarding be in the same beta, or do we gate BYOK behind the first audit rollout? Asking because Sales has two pilots needing different guarantees.

nora: Security preference is to gate BYOK. Bringing customer-managed keys into the live audit stream changes threat model + access patterns. :warning:

aj: From eng POV gating BYOK is easier. We can ship audit streaming to our managed KMS quickly. BYOK needs handshake, escrow workflows, and key rotation integration. ETA delta ~3 sprints.

sam: Ops question — what are the SLOs for audit query vs ingest? If audit streaming is ingest-only with 24h colding window, that's a different infra design than immediate queryable index. That affects cost profile a lot.

li: Legal: also consider e-discovery holds. If a customer requests a legal hold, retention toggles must be instant and auditable. BYOK complicates ability to produce logs if keys are lost — we need playbook language for key-loss scenarios.

marie: Proposed compromise: ship audit streaming (managed keys) + retention controls first. Offer BYOK as a controlled opt-in feature post-beta with clear acceptance criteria and legal playbook. Thoughts?

nora: +1 to staged approach. Must include these security must-haves before BYOK flips to prod:
- documented key escrow/escrow alternatives
- role-separated key access for Redwood ops
- cryptographic proof of exportability for audit bundles

aj: Tech checklist for audit streaming (managed keys):
- event schema v1 (timestamp, tenant_id, request_id, model, route, decision_trace)
- kafka -> transformer -> s3 parquet landing + small lucene index for 7d hot window
- envelope encryption via our managed KMS, metadata header contains kms-key-id
- retention TTL config per-tenant, default 90 days, admin toggle

sam: Query SLA proposal: search over hot index <= 2s p95, cold archive queries async (job) with 24h completion SLA. We should include sampling options to reduce cost for large tenants.

li: Add contract language items for BYOK pilot: responsibility matrix for key custody, procedures for legal hold retrieval, and customer acknowledgment for inability to recover logs if key lost.

ops-bot: Created ticket PROD-1589 — "audit-streaming-managed-keys-+retention-gating" assigned to @aj, @nora, due 1761300000. Link: https://rwd/issue/PROD-1589

marie: Acceptance criteria I'm proposing for the initial audit streaming launch (managed keys):
- ingest pipeline deployed to prod with event schema v1 and telemetry (token-level cost traced)
- retention controls: tenant TTL + legal hold flag exposed in console + backend enforcement
- hot index search SLA validated in perf tests (2s p95)
- documentation: runbook for legal holds & retention export in <30m window
- contract stub for BYOK opt-in that we can share with pilot customers

nora: Also require a security review sign-off and a test that verifies exported audit bundles are encrypted and include verifiable metadata (kms-key-id, integrity hash).

aj: I'll scope infra tasks and post a breakdown in PROD-1589 tomorrow. If anyone has perf targets for expected eps (events/sec) per tier, drop them here — I can use them to size the transformer.

marie: FYI sales pilot one expects ~500 eps sustained, another is 50k/day bursty. We should have a default burst protection policy.

sam: For 50k/day bursty — transformer/ingest autoscale + SQS buffer is safest. We'll draft a recommended burst SLA to include in the playbook.

li: I'll draft BYOK pilot contract language and share a short checklist for legal hold responsibilities.

marie: Great — next step: aj to post a task breakdown in the ticket, nora to outline security gating checklist, li to draft pilot contract. We'll reconvene EOD Friday for sign-off. :thumbsup:
